svg.text: TOP STORIES FROM AROUND THE WORLD
Trump in Shenzhen for APEC: Historic
Trilateral Talks with Xi and Putin
President Trump meets with Chinese President Xi Jinping
and Russian President Putin in Shenzhen for trilateral
negotiations on nuclear arms control, the Ukraine conflict,
and trade realignment at the 2026 APEC summit.

Gulf Conflict Widens as Strikes Target
Drone and missile strikes target US military installations in
Kuwait and Bahrain, escalating tensions across the Persian
Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz shipping corridor.
Hegseth Visits Caracas While El Nino
Defense Secretary Hegseth visits Venezuela to reset
US-Venezuela military ties. Meanwhile, severe El Nino
storms trigger catastrophic flooding across South Florida.
